title: OpenAI's Codex Plugin For Claude Code Isn't Two Commands
description:
OpenAI publishes an official plugin that runs Codex from inside Claude Code. It sits on OpenAI's own GitHub org under Apache 2.0 with more than 32,000 stars.

Nearly every post about it quotes two commands. The README lists four: add the marketplace, install the plugin, reload plugins, then run /codex:setup, which only checks whether Codex is on your machine at all. You also need Node.js 18.18 or later and a Codex sign-in, though if you already use Codex the plugin picks that account up on its own.

Then there's what the review commands can't do. /codex:review and /codex:adversarial-review are both read only, and the README says so: they will not perform any changes, and they do not fix code. The one that actually writes is /codex:rescue, which takes a bug, a fix or a previous Codex task and works on it. A ChatGPT subscription, including the Free tier, is enough to run either one.

Plugin: https://github.com/openai/codex-plugin-cc
